method: 4x2 contact sheet visual review; gait-only review, packing alignment pending

frames.issue: Seam brings a high knee directly to contact; identical contact to frame5.
frames.correction: Reduce preceding recovery height; retain near forward contact as A.

frames.issue: After1, rear boot lifts plausibly and support moves toward under pelvis; down compression still weak.
frames.correction: Retain contact A leg supporting, lower pelvis slightly.

frames.issue: After2, far knee passes behind near support thigh, improving passing. Following4 swaps its depth identity.
frames.correction: Keep A support under pelvis and B swing behind/through.

frames.issue: After3 far-knee passing, raised knee becomes foreground near knee; leg identity changes and lift is excessive.
frames.correction: Lower knee lift by about half; extend swing shin toward contact5.

frames.issue: Repeats frame1 near-side forward leg instead of reversing support after4.
frames.correction: Foreground thigh must slope backward LEFT from hip, foreground boot at back LEFT; background thigh slopes forward RIGHT, background boot at front RIGHT. Reverse crotch overlap relative1.

frames.issue: Repeats first-half down pose rather than near leg lifting behind opposite support.
frames.correction: Lift near boot behind while far leg bears weight.

frames.issue: Repeats first-half passing silhouette; near/far crossing does not reverse.
frames.correction: Pass near bent leg visibly in FRONT of far support shin.

frames.issue: Repeats high-knee4 and does not approach contact1 smoothly.
frames.correction: Extend near swing leg toward contact1, with modest toe clearance, far heel lifted.
